steps.title: King’s Edge product and migration foundation
steps.summary: Define the product foundation needed to begin delivery. Agree the first release, the flexible activity model, the migration and cutover route, the minimum King’s Canvas proposition, the Accredible exit requirements and the responsibilities for accepting each capability into live service. Complete this definition during November and December 2026 as the core multidisciplinary team becomes available.

outputs.title: Year-one product scope and release sequence
outputs.summary: A prioritised release plan covering opportunity discovery, participation, projects and experiences, King’s Canvas, evidence and digital recognition.

outputs.title: Flexible activity model
outputs.summary: An agreed model for events, self-paced activities, projects and sustained experiences, including the core information, participation rules and completion states required for each.

outputs.title: Migration and service-continuity plan
outputs.summary: A clear route for migrating the current opportunity catalogue, required historical records, content and operational processes without disrupting the live Edge service.

outputs.title: Digital-recognition delivery plan
outputs.summary: The sequence for building badge infrastructure, delivering the first King’s Edge badges in parallel and completing migration and cutover before Accredible renewal.

outputs.title: King’s Canvas minimum proposition
outputs.summary: The bounded scope for an April prototype covering needs, aspirations, guided reflection, AI-supported coaching and links into opportunities.

outputs.title: Product ownership and acceptance model
outputs.summary: Named responsibilities for product decisions, operational readiness, testing, acceptance, service ownership and ongoing support.

steps.title: Opportunity discovery, participation and evidence
steps.summary: Build the production core of King’s Edge in Azure so students can find and participate in a much wider range of opportunities, record appropriate evidence and staff can manage the offer through one flexible service. Begin in January 2027 in parallel with completion of the wider Azure delivery foundations.

outputs.title: Azure-hosted King’s Edge service
outputs.summary: A production-ready version of the core Edge service operating in the agreed institutional Azure environment.

outputs.title: Opportunity catalogue and activity records
outputs.summary: A flexible catalogue supporting events, self-paced activities, projects and sustained experiences without forcing every opportunity into the same format.

outputs.title: Search, discovery and curation
outputs.summary: Student-facing search, filtering, browsing, collections and targeted curation that make relevant opportunities easier to find.

outputs.title: Registration and participation journeys
outputs.summary: Registration, attendance, progress and completion journeys appropriate to different activity types.

outputs.title: Targeting and access controls
outputs.summary: Cohort restrictions, invitation routes and access rules for opportunities intended for particular student groups.

outputs.title: Activity-owner administration
outputs.summary: Staff tools for creating, updating, publishing and managing activities, participants and communications.

outputs.title: Independent activity and evidence capture
outputs.summary: A proportionate route for students to record eligible activity and supporting evidence beyond activity directly managed through the platform.

outputs.title: Migration, reporting and audit
outputs.summary: Migration of the required catalogue and historical records, with operational reporting, audit trails and a tested cutover and continuity plan.

steps.title: Digital badge infrastructure
steps.summary: Build the reusable in-house infrastructure needed to define, issue, display, verify and govern digital badges. Deliver the service incrementally so the first King’s Edge badges can be configured and tested alongside the infrastructure build rather than waiting for the whole service to be finished.

outputs.title: Badge-definition service
outputs.summary: Tools and data structures for defining badge metadata, criteria, evidence requirements and validity.

outputs.title: Issuer and administrator controls
outputs.summary: Roles, permissions and workflows for authorised issuers and central administrators.

outputs.title: Issuance engine
outputs.summary: Infrastructure supporting automatic, staff-awarded and approved claim-based issuance.

outputs.title: Student badge record
outputs.summary: A student-facing record of earned badges and the evidence or criteria associated with them.

outputs.title: Public verification
outputs.summary: A secure public verification page for confirming that a credential is valid and has not been revoked.

outputs.title: Revocation, audit and reporting
outputs.summary: Administrative controls and records for correcting, revoking, auditing and reporting recognition activity.

outputs.title: Supported production service
outputs.summary: Monitoring, security, accessibility, documentation, support and service ownership sufficient for live institutional use.

steps.title: King’s Canvas prototype
steps.summary: Begin active prototyping in April 2027, once the opportunity-service and badge-infrastructure work is established. Create and test a bounded working version of King’s Canvas that helps students articulate needs and aspirations, form a revisitable plan and move towards relevant opportunities without committing prematurely to a full production service.

outputs.title: Visual planning interface
outputs.summary: A clear interface through which students can explore and organise their needs, aspirations, priorities and intended next steps.

outputs.title: Saved and revisitable plan
outputs.summary: A persistent personal plan that students can return to and update rather than completing as a one-off exercise.

outputs.title: Structured planning prompts
outputs.summary: Guided questions and prompts that help students move from broad aspirations towards practical priorities.

outputs.title: Bounded AI coaching
outputs.summary: Carefully constrained AI-supported dialogue that helps students articulate options without presenting itself as authoritative advice.

outputs.title: Prototype opportunity links
outputs.summary: Early connections from the Canvas into relevant parts of the live opportunity catalogue, initially using controlled rules and curated routes.

outputs.title: Closed student testing
outputs.summary: Structured testing with a limited group of students, including accessibility and trust testing.

outputs.title: Prototype evidence and beta decision
outputs.summary: Findings, design changes, assurance requirements and a clear decision on the scope of the subsequent beta.

steps.title: Core King’s Edge badges and Accredible migration
steps.summary: Configure, test and release the first King’s Edge recognition products alongside the badge-infrastructure build. Complete migration and production cutover by the end of August 2027 so the Accredible subscription can be stood down before renewal.

outputs.title: Core King’s Edge badge set
outputs.summary: The first agreed badge definitions, criteria and evidence rules required for King’s Edge recognition.

outputs.title: Automatic completion badges
outputs.summary: Badges issued from verified completion data where the activity and recognition rules allow automation.

outputs.title: Staff-awarded recognition
outputs.summary: A controlled route for authorised staff to award badges for eligible activity and achievement.

outputs.title: Verified claims for external activity
outputs.summary: A controlled route for students to claim recognition for eligible activity completed outside the Edge platform.

outputs.title: Issuer and badge migration
outputs.summary: Migration of the required issuers, badge definitions and associated administration from Accredible.

outputs.title: Credential-record migration
outputs.summary: Migration or preservation of the credential records required to maintain continuity and verification.

outputs.title: Accredible cutover and exit
outputs.summary: Validated production cutover, support arrangements and continuity completed before the September 2027 renewal point.

steps.title: Projects, experiences and curated pathways
steps.summary: Extend King’s Edge beyond event administration into deeper projects, sustained experiences, self-paced participation and curated developmental routes. Put these capabilities into controlled use and resolve the most important issues before wider live operation.

outputs.title: Project and sustained-experience spaces
outputs.summary: Structured spaces for longer activities with defined participants, purpose, duration, responsibilities and completion requirements.

outputs.title: Milestones and progress tracking
outputs.summary: Progress states, milestones and completion tracking suited to projects and experiences that unfold over time.

outputs.title: Resources, groups and communications
outputs.summary: Resource hosting, participant groups and communications that support activity delivery rather than only registration.

outputs.title: Submissions, outputs and showcases
outputs.summary: Routes for participants to submit work, record outputs and make selected achievements visible.

outputs.title: Self-paced and on-demand participation
outputs.summary: Activity journeys that support participation without a fixed event date while remaining inside the common activity model.

outputs.title: Collections and progression pathways
outputs.summary: Curated groupings that help students move through coherent sets of opportunities from lighter-touch to deeper experiences.

outputs.title: Provider-curated spaces
outputs.summary: Branded and managed spaces through which faculties, services and approved providers can curate their offer.

outputs.title: Controlled-use evidence
outputs.summary: Student and staff findings, prioritised fixes and hardening requirements for live operation.

steps.title: King’s Canvas beta and opportunity matching
steps.summary: Develop the April prototype into a broader controlled beta. Test how students move from their plans into relevant opportunities, how the Canvas remains useful over time and how aggregated needs and aspirations can inform curation and commissioning without overclaiming the maturity of recommendation technology.

outputs.title: Controlled King’s Canvas beta
outputs.summary: A more robust version available to a wider but still bounded student cohort.

outputs.title: Plan-to-opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Tested rules and curated recommendations connecting needs, aspirations and priorities to relevant live opportunities.

outputs.title: Progress and next-step prompts
outputs.summary: Revisitable prompts that help students update their plan and identify practical next steps over time.

outputs.title: Connections to projects and pathways
outputs.summary: Routes from Canvas priorities into projects, sustained experiences and curated progression pathways.

outputs.title: Needs and provision insight
outputs.summary: Aggregated, privacy-aware insight into recurring student needs, aspiration patterns and potential gaps in the opportunity offer.

outputs.title: Beta evaluation and launch requirements
outputs.summary: Evidence on usefulness, trust, accessibility and operational implications, with a prioritised list of changes required for supported live use.

steps.title: Live King’s Edge service and product operations
steps.summary: Bring the separately developed capabilities into one supported live King’s Edge service. Establish the product, operational and assurance arrangements needed to run and improve the service beyond individual delivery epics. The Accredible exit remains an earlier August 2027 deadline.

outputs.title: Coherent student experience
outputs.summary: Joined-up navigation and interaction across opportunity discovery, participation, projects and experiences, King’s Canvas, evidence and digital recognition.

outputs.title: Production assurance
outputs.summary: Completed accessibility, security, privacy, performance and operational-readiness assurance for the live service.

outputs.title: Live product analytics
outputs.summary: Operational and product analytics showing how students and providers use the service and where journeys need improvement.

outputs.title: Product and service ownership
outputs.summary: Named decision rights and responsibilities for the roadmap, content, service operation, data, support and ongoing improvement.

outputs.title: Support and release operations
outputs.summary: Documented support, incident, release, maintenance, monitoring and recovery arrangements.

outputs.title: Adoption and transition
outputs.summary: Guidance, communications and transition support for students, activity providers and operational teams.

steps.title: Personalised planning, progression and reflection
steps.summary: Use evidence from live operation to strengthen the developmental journey through King’s Edge. Help students move from planning into relevant activity, from lighter-touch participation into deeper experiences, and from completed activity into reflection, evidence and recognition.

outputs.title: Improved planning-to-opportunity matching
outputs.summary: Stronger connections from Canvas needs, aspirations and priorities into relevant opportunities and next steps.

outputs.title: Progression pathways
outputs.summary: Collections and pathways that help students move from short or introductory activity into deeper projects and sustained experiences.

outputs.title: Evidence and recognition connections
outputs.summary: Clear movement from activity progress and completion into verified evidence and the recognition routes led through 2.4.3.

outputs.title: Post-activity reflection
outputs.summary: Proportionate prompts that help students reflect on what they did, what changed and what they may do next.

outputs.title: Recognition rules and records
outputs.summary: The Edge product changes needed to apply the recognition proposition led through 2.4.3, using the skills language, governance and assurance supplied through 2.1.3 and 2.2.3.

outputs.title: Offer insight and continuous curation
outputs.summary: Use participation and Canvas evidence to improve the opportunity offer and identify areas requiring stronger provision.

steps.title: King’s Edge in the shared student app
steps.summary: Move King’s Edge into the shared student-app environment while retaining clear ownership of the Edge proposition, content, curation, developmental journeys and recognition rules.

outputs.title: Shared home and navigation
outputs.summary: King’s Edge available through the common student-app home, navigation and interaction patterns.

outputs.title: Shared profile, search and communications
outputs.summary: Edge journeys using the common profile, search, communications and personalisation capabilities where they meet the need.

outputs.title: Continuity of records and journeys
outputs.summary: Student activity, evidence, recognition and planning records preserved through the transition into the shared environment.

outputs.title: Retirement of duplicated functions
outputs.summary: Edge-specific functions replaced by common Hub capabilities where those capabilities are ready, appropriate and supportable.

outputs.title: Focused Edge roadmap
outputs.summary: A selective continuing roadmap centred on opportunity quality, King’s Canvas, projects and experiences, evidence and recognition.

steps.title: Mature King’s Edge product domain
steps.summary: Complete the transition from a separately evolving Edge platform into a stable product domain within the Student Experience Hub, with clear ownership and a routine continuous-improvement cycle.

outputs.title: Stable shared product domain
outputs.summary: King’s Edge operating through shared app, data, integration, profile, communication and service capabilities.

outputs.title: Enduring ownership
outputs.summary: Named product, service and operational ownership with clear decision rights and support responsibilities.

outputs.title: Analytics and continuous improvement
outputs.summary: A routine cycle for monitoring reach, participation, depth, progression, service quality and product performance and prioritising improvements.

outputs.title: Controlled rationalisation
outputs.summary: Redundant Edge-specific components retired where continuity, data integrity and support are assured.

outputs.title: Route to later capabilities
outputs.summary: A controlled path for later portfolio, articulation and enhanced-record features when the propositions led through 2.4.3 and the required data foundations are mature.
